narrative.overview:
This records the implemented six-image direction approved for AI Chat, its drawer, AI Call, live Translator and Voice Over. White working surfaces, peach accents, generous rounded controls and the existing black/orange Kilas identity follow the supplied references. AI Call switches to a dedicated dark viewport; the surrounding product remains light.

The source of visual authority is [the six-reference contract](KILAS_SIX_REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATION.md), the current `client-hub/static/kilas_reference_ui.css`, participating templates and their existing handlers. This guide describes the finished correction batch, including the centered closed-drawer canvas, full narrow labels, Call header/status capsule and compact Voice Over spacing. It does not imply a deployment or final reviewer verdict.
keyCharacteristics: White/peach AI workspace with deliberate orange actions and selection.
Existing Kilas logo asset and self-hosted Manrope.
Header and overlay drawer at every width; centered work without a reserved rail.
Separate setup and running compositions for Translator and Call.
Actual scripts, histories, account state and controls remain authoritative.

rules.name: The Scoped Reference Rule
rules.body: Apply these tokens only to the named AI reference surfaces; preserve Finance and the other existing product themes.

dos: Do keep the genuine existing Kilas identity and self-hosted Manrope.
Do use the six-reference contract and current scoped CSS when extending these surfaces.
Do preserve complete labels, visible focus, actual runtime state and the existing controls.
Do keep UI locale separate from user content and media language settings.
Do preserve the 4,000-character script cap, fresh entry and intentional history access.
donts: Don't apply this surface palette or geometry to Finance, Assist, admin or Creative Services.
Don't replace real handlers, provider gates, consent or persistent histories with visual stand-ins.
Don't infer successful provider audio, deployment or accessibility certification from synthetic captures.

behaviorSafeguards.history: Fresh editor unless explicit handoff/draft; History starts closed and remains intentional.
behaviorSafeguards.locale: Explicit UI copy only; preserve script/content and independent call/media language settings. Localized count follows document language. Exact Connecting/Reconnecting keys include source ellipsis punctuation.
behaviorSafeguards.call: Native modal; pinned brand/title, direct-child real status capsule and footer; scrollable body; cancellation and focus restoration. Setup does not start capture.
behaviorSafeguards.translator: Explicit consent, distinct language pair, direction click starts capture; account language preference never persists consent/audio.

evidence.kind: Local synthetic visual evidence; final verdict, test/deployment results and physical/provider quality remain release-report concerns.

narrative.overview:
The customer workspace feels calm, precise and trustworthy. White working surfaces, a neutral navigation rail and charcoal text let actual conversations, files and business tasks lead. Kilas orange carries identity and meaningful actions. The premium character comes from hierarchy, readable measures and consistent controls.

This records the implemented white workspace in `client-hub/static/kilas_premium.css`, its scoped Finance presentation layer and the current customer templates. The owner's 2026-10-03 pinned brief replaces the historical dark customer direction and the audit-only visual restrictions in PRODUCT.md. Existing capabilities and permissions remain product truth. The theme is opt-in through `kilas-light`; Assist and admin keep their existing visual systems. Finance now shares Manrope and the neutral workbench surface through a scoped presentation layer. Its established financial workflows and overall shell geometry remain; presentation adds readable controls and safe metric-text wrapping.
keyCharacteristics: White working surfaces and neutral navigation.
Manrope typography with a compact Finance body role.
Deliberate orange identity, actions and selection states.
Document-style assistant replies and compact persistent files.
Task-led content with restrained borders and elevation.

rules.name: The Deliberate Orange Rule
rules.body: Use orange for identity, meaningful actions, links and selection; keep the main working canvas white.

rules.name: The Finance Density Rule
rules.body: Finance uses the compact finance-body role with Manrope; preserve its established task hierarchy rather than applying the customer heading ramp wholesale.

rules.name: The Actual Work Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy around the real task, conversation, connection or account state; do not populate decorative dashboards with synthetic metrics.

rules.name: The Content Before Chrome Rule
rules.body: Let spacing, borders and tonal surfaces organize ordinary content; reserve the customer floating shadow for menus and dialogs.

dos: Do use the opt-in customer theme and its recorded tokens for new customer surfaces.
Do lead with the actual task and readable content.
Do retain visible focus, meaningful labels and real status text.
Do use the compact Finance body role while preserving its overall geometry and financial behavior.
Do preserve persistent file links, chat history and existing permissions.
donts: Don't return the customer workspace to a dark primary background.
Don't add synthetic metrics, decorative AI art or unrequested mode controls.
Don't use the customer theme to restyle Assist or admin globally.
Don't treat orange as the background for the whole workspace.
